frame.revision_note: Physical D frame preserved; v06 frame label was a document revision, not a new transform.

pickup_above_clearance.note: Above means +Y/back of desk on the plan; preserve the existing fixed overhead RGB camera. No new desktop objects, mounts or cable piles in this band.

delivery.height_note: 115 mm is an inherited Q-centre candidate, not a measured support height.

fixed_devices.robot_mount_note: Base-axis XY approx (600,25); book elevation approx 15 mm. Do not interpret the placeholder base Z=0 as a calibrated mechanical origin.

required_before_physical_execution: mark and survey G/B/handover; no separate return-zone marking
preserve pickup area and its rear clearance
joint limits, IK and continuous whole-arm/tool sweep
new H/P_PRE reachability and full-hand visibility
original pick pose/version reservation per task
vacant original-footprint verification including tool and uncertainty clearance
support height, release gap and local retreat validation at pickup surface
return branches from actual task states; cancellation and fault-state handling
point_semantics: XYZ waypoints describe the 30 mm object centre Q in D; empty-arm points describe the virtual grasped-object reference. Convert to TCP with tool orientation; never send D/Q directly as robot Cartesian commands.
path_rules: Keep the hand inside gesture zone G during pickup, lift and buffer transit; no hand in B.
Enter the handover window only after arrival at P_PRE; PALM_READY needs fresh full-hand visibility.
Release only after the support and current task state are verified; stop motion on invalid/expired READY.
Release then withdraw locally along a validated direction before the transit to I.
B is a reserved arm corridor/holding envelope; no unplanned desktop objects within it.
All segment curves, not only endpoints, require reach, joint and whole-arm checks.
Cancellation returns a known held object to its own reserved original pickup pose only when return preconditions hold.
No separate return tray and no automatic alternate placement in pickup area.
Freeze changes to the active task original footprint; verify vacancy before final descent.

preconditions: Object remains held; grip/payload state is known.
Robot feedback, drive control, communications and calibration remain usable.
Current state has a validated route back to the original pickup approach.
Original footprint plus carried-object/tool/uncertainty clearance is confirmed vacant.
Destination pose is still within the valid pickup area; no obstacles or hands in approach.

steps.route: verified branch for the actual current state; no arbitrary straight shortcut

steps.required: fresh vacancy evidence; if occluded/uncertain obtain clear view from a validated pose or operator confirmation

return_to_pickup_path.on_occupied_or_uncertain_destination: Do not descend or release; hold only if drive/grip remain healthy, otherwise use the fault-specific stop procedure and request manual intervention.

cases.grasp_failed_before_lift_no_payload: Withdraw via validated empty-gripper route; no object return.
cases.object_dropped_or_grip_unknown: Stop task; locate object and request manual intervention, do not run a blind carrying route.
cases.drive_fault_feedback_loss_or_link_loss: Do not attempt automatic return motion; use fault-specific stop/hold procedure.
cases.already_delivered_to_person: Finish empty-gripper retreat; do not attempt to retrieve from person.
